message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello Mr Lis,

You offered a quality commitment alongside your price, so quality is the right place to start. Our options turn that commitment into the trade: a tighter ppm commitment and no chargeback per complaint.

On quality:
Your quality was 2376 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70140@2026Q3).

On price history:
Our orders of Bearing bracket HN with you were placed at EUR 46.33 on 2024-10-18 (po:4500011561-10), EUR 46.33 on 2025-06-20 (po:4500012598-10), EUR 45.15 on 2026-01-19 (po:4500013441-20) and EUR 45.15 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014429-10): the price has not risen.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: quality commitment 1,500 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 39.85.
Option B: quality commitment 800 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.18.
Option C: quality commitment 300 ppm; chargeback EUR 0.00 per complaint; unit price EUR 40.41.

Option A is the package we can approve. It sets a quality commitment your foundry can plan around, and the price follows the history of our orders.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. 

Our main proposal is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Hi guys, we looked at your numbers and can do the 1500 ppm with no chargeback, but it means more sorting on our side. We can offer EUR 46.50 for this setup. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.50 per unit, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. If you want a better price, we really need to look at faster payment, since that's a big help for us right now. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
